product.name: AI-curated Conversation Flows
product.description: Generates conversational interview flows from natural language descriptions to structure AI-moderated interviews.

product.name: No-code Conversational Flow Editor
product.description: A drag-and-drop editor for building and customizing conversational interview flows using natural language logic.

product.name: Multi-modal Conversational Interviews
product.description: Conducts AI-moderated interviews via voice, video, and text in over 50 languages with human-like interaction.

product.name: Conversational Insights and Reporting
product.description: Provides real-time reports combining qualitative and quantitative insights with deep-linked citations from interviews.

product.name: Structured Data Extraction and Visualization
product.description: Automatically extracts clean, structured data from conversations and provides pre-built visualizations for analysis.
